svg.title: Survodutide: the same trials, two ways of counting
svg.desc: Average weight lost at 76 weeks. SYNCHRONIZE-1, no diabetes: 6.0 mg with everyone counted 13.0% vs 5.4% placebo; Boehringer’s up-to figure if everyone stayed on treatment 16.6% vs 3.2%. SYNCHRONIZE-2, type 2 diabetes: 6.0 mg with everyone counted 9.8% vs 3.9%; up-to figure if everyone stayed on 13.1% vs 3.1%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
